question: Taux d absentéisme par département
sql: SELECT af.libelle_poste, COUNT(DISTINCT a.nudoss) as nb_absents, COUNT(DISTINCT e.nudoss) as nb_employes, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.nudoss)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.nudoss),0) AS NUMERIC), 2) as taux FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_affectation af ON e.nudoss=af.nudoss AND af.flag_affectation_active=1 LEFT JOIN fait.fait_absence a ON e.nudoss=a.nudoss WHERE e.flag_employe_actif=1 AND af.libelle_poste IS NOT NULL GROUP BY af.libelle_poste ORDER BY taux DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Top 10 des employés les plus anciens
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, MIN(c.date_debut_contrat) as premiere_embauche, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, MIN(c.date_debut_contrat)))::integer as anciennete FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND c.date_debut_contrat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.nom, e.prenom, e.nudoss ORDER BY anciennete DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Employés avec plus de 10 ans d'ancienneté

sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, c.libelle_type_contrat, c.date_debut_contrat FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss WHERE UPPER(c.libelle_type_contrat) LIKE '%INTERIM%' ORDER BY e.nom LIMIT 100;

question: Contrats qui expirent ce mois
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, c.libelle_type_contrat, c.date_fin_contrat FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.date_fin_contrat) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.date_fin_contrat) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY c.date_fin_contrat;

question: Employés dont le contrat se termine bientôt
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, c.libelle_type_contrat, c.date_fin_contrat FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss WHERE c.date_fin_contrat BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY c.date_fin_contrat;

question: Masse salariale totale
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.salaire_mensuel) AS NUMERIC), 2) as masse_salariale FROM fait.fait_contrat c JOIN dim.dim_employe e ON c.nudoss = e.nudoss WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND c.salaire_mensuel IS NOT NULL;

question: Masse salariale par département
sql: SELECT af.libelle_poste, ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.salaire_mensuel) AS NUMERIC), 2) as masse_salariale FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss LEFT JOIN fait.fait_affectation af ON e.nudoss = af.nudoss AND af.flag_affectation_active = 1 WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND c.salaire_mensuel IS NOT NULL GROUP BY af.libelle_poste ORDER BY masse_salariale DESC;

question: Employés avec salaire supérieur à 3000
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, af.libelle_poste, c.salaire_mensuel FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss LEFT JOIN fait.fait_affectation af ON e.nudoss = af.nudoss AND af.flag_affectation_active = 1 WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND c.salaire_mensuel > 3000 ORDER BY c.salaire_mensuel DESC LIMIT 100;

question: Employés avec salaire inférieur à 1000
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, af.libelle_poste, c.salaire_mensuel FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss LEFT JOIN fait.fait_affectation af ON e.nudoss = af.nudoss AND af.flag_affectation_active = 1 WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND c.salaire_mensuel < 1000 ORDER BY c.salaire_mensuel ASC LIMIT 100;

question: Employés sans affectation
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_affectation af ON e.nudoss = af.nudoss AND af.flag_affectation_active = 1 WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND af.nudoss IS NULL ORDER BY e.nom;

question: Postes disponibles
sql: SELECT DISTINCT af.libelle_poste FROM fait.fait_affectation af WHERE af.flag_affectation_active = 1 ORDER BY af.libelle_poste;

question: Combien de postes différents ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT af.libelle_poste) as total_postes FROM fait.fait_affectation af WHERE af.flag_affectation_active = 1;

question: Absences cette semaine
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, a.libelle_motif_absence, a.date_debut_absence FROM fait.fait_absence a LEFT JOIN dim.dim_employe e ON a.nudoss = e.nudoss LEFT JOIN dim.dim_calendrier cal ON DATE(a.date_debut_absence) = cal.date WHERE cal.semaine = EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND cal.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 50;

question: Absences ce mois
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, a.libelle_motif_absence, a.date_debut_absence FROM fait.fait_absence a LEFT JOIN dim.dim_employe e ON a.nudoss = e.nudoss WHERE a.mois_absence = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND a.annee_absence = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY a.date_debut_absence LIMIT 100;

question: Employés absents ce mois
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.nudoss) as nb_absents FROM fait.fait_absence a WHERE a.mois_absence = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND a.annee_absence = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE);

question: Pyramide des âges
sql: SELECT e.tranche_age, e.libelle_sexe, COUNT(DISTINCT e.nudoss) as total FROM dim.dim_employe e WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 GROUP BY e.tranche_age, e.libelle_sexe ORDER BY e.tranche_age;

question: Employés nés en 1990
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, e.date_naissance FROM dim.dim_employe e WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.date_naissance) = 1990 AND e.flag_employe_actif = 1 ORDER BY e.nom;

question: Ancienneté par département
sql: SELECT af.libelle_poste, ROUND(CAST(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, c.date_debut_contrat))) AS NUMERIC), 1) as anciennete_moyenne FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss LEFT JOIN fait.fait_affectation af ON e.nudoss = af.nudoss AND af.flag_affectation_active = 1 WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND c.date_debut_contrat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY af.libelle_poste ORDER BY anciennete_moyenne DESC;

question: Quel département a la plus grande ancienneté ?
sql: SELECT af.libelle_poste, ROUND(CAST(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, c.date_debut_contrat))) AS NUMERIC), 1) as anciennete_moyenne FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss LEFT JOIN fait.fait_affectation af ON e.nudoss = af.nudoss AND af.flag_affectation_active = 1 WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND c.date_debut_contrat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY af.libelle_poste ORDER BY anciennete_moyenne DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Employés avec plus de 5 absences
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, COUNT(*) as nb_absences FROM fait.fait_absence a LEFT JOIN dim.dim_employe e ON a.nudoss = e.nudoss GROUP BY e.nom, e.prenom, e.nudoss HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY nb_absences DESC;

question: Top 5 des employés les plus absents
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, COUNT(*) as nb_absences, SUM(a.duree_absence_jours) as total_jours FROM fait.fait_absence a LEFT JOIN dim.dim_employe e ON a.nudoss = e.nudoss GROUP BY e.nom, e.prenom, e.nudoss ORDER BY nb_absences DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Embauches par jour de la semaine
sql: SELECT cal.jour_semaine, COUNT(DISTINCT e.nudoss) as total FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss LEFT JOIN dim.dim_calendrier cal ON DATE(c.date_debut_contrat) = cal.date WHERE c.date_debut_contrat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cal.jour_semaine ORDER BY total DESC;

question: Combien d'hommes actifs ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.nudoss) as total FROM dim.dim_employe e WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND e.code_sexe = '1';

question: Combien de femmes actives ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.nudoss) as total FROM dim.dim_employe e WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND e.code_sexe = '2';

question: Salaire moyen des hommes
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(c.salaire_mensuel) AS NUMERIC), 2) as salaire_moyen FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND e.code_sexe = '1' AND c.salaire_mensuel IS NOT NULL;

question: Salaire moyen des femmes
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(c.salaire_mensuel) AS NUMERIC), 2) as salaire_moyen FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND e.code_sexe = '2' AND c.salaire_mensuel IS NOT NULL;

question: Employés en CDI depuis plus de 5 ans
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, c.date_debut_contrat, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, c.date_debut_contrat))::integer as anciennete FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND UPPER(c.libelle_type_contrat) LIKE '%CDI%' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, c.date_debut_contrat)) >= 5 ORDER BY anciennete DESC LIMIT 100;

question: Absences par année
sql: SELECT a.annee_absence, COUNT(*) as nombre, SUM(a.duree_absence_jours) as total_jours FROM fait.fait_absence a GROUP BY a.annee_absence ORDER BY a.annee_absence;

question: Employé le plus récemment embauché
sql: SELECT e.nom, e.prenom, c.date_debut_contrat, af.libelle_poste FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss LEFT JOIN fait.fait_affectation af ON e.nudoss = af.nudoss AND af.flag_affectation_active = 1 WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1 AND c.date_debut_contrat IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.date_debut_contrat DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Tableau de bord RH complet
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.nudoss) as total_employes, ROUND(CAST(AVG(c.salaire_mensuel) AS NUMERIC), 2) as salaire_moyen, ROUND(CAST(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, c.date_debut_contrat))) AS NUMERIC), 1) as anciennete_moyenne FROM dim.dim_employe e LEFT JOIN fait.fait_contrat c ON e.nudoss = c.nudoss WHERE e.flag_employe_actif = 1;
